nodes.description: msg.sender - caller controlled untrusted address used for authorization checks, allowance spending and token movements
address private owner - privileged address that bypasses whitelist checks and gates admin functions
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf - token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance - spending allowances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic
mapping(address => bool) private canSale - whitelist that disables sale restrictions in ensure()
mapping(address => uint256) private _onSaleNum - per-address sale counter incremented unchecked
uint256 private _minSale - minimum sale amount checked in condition()
uint256 private _maxSale - maximum sale amount checked in condition()
uint256 private _saleNum - maximum number of sales allowed per address
address tradeAddress - whitelisted trading address that bypasses ensure() restrictions
uint public totalSupply - total token supply set in constructor
address constant UNI - hardcoded Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure()
uint constant public decimals = 18 - scaling factor used in init()
string public name - token name
string public symbol - token symbol
mapping(address => uint) private _balances - ERC20 library balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) private _allowances - ERC20 library allowances
UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable - forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
UniswapExchange.ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view - whitelist based sale restriction checker
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable - performs allowance spend and unchecked balance updates
UniswapExchange.approve(address _spender, uint _value) payable - sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
UniswapExchange.condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view - enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits
UniswapExchange.delegate(address a, bytes b) payable - owner only arbitrary delegatecall
UniswapExchange.init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) - owner only configuration of sale limits
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) payable - owner only batch balance transfer
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address addr) - owner only update of the trade whitelist address
UniswapExchange.pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure - computes Uniswap pair address
UniswapExchange constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable - mints supply and sets owner
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) internal - SafeMath based balance transfer
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint amount) internal - writes _allowances
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20 token, bytes data) private - performs low level external call to token
Context._msgSender() internal view returns(address payable) - returns msg.sender
a.delegatecall(b) - arbitrary delegatecall to an owner supplied address, allowing storage takeover
address(token).call(data) - unchecked external low level call executed before state finalization
balanceOf[_from] -= _value - unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[_to] += _value - unchecked addition without SafeMath
uint total = _value * _tos.length - unchecked multiplication without SafeMath
_onSaleNum[_from]++ - unchecked counter increment
_from address parameter of UniswapExchange.transferFrom
_to address parameter of UniswapExchange.transferFrom
_value uint parameter of UniswapExchange.transferFrom
_spender address parameter of UniswapExchange.approve
a address parameter of UniswapExchange.delegate used as delegatecall target
b bytes parameter of UniswapExchange.delegate used as delegatecall calldata
saleNum uint256 parameter of UniswapExchange.init
token uint256 parameter of UniswapExchange.init used for _minSale
maxToken uint256 parameter of UniswapExchange.init used for _maxSale
_tos address[] parameter of UniswapExchange.batchSend
_value uint parameter of UniswapExchange.batchSend
addr address parameter of UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress
address _to loop local inside batchSend
uint i loop index inside batchSend
uint total local inside batchSend computed by unchecked multiplication

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from and its allowance is spent on behalf of _from
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the arbitrary delegatecall
require(msg.sender == owner) gates init configuration
require(msg.sender == owner) gates batchSend
require(msg.sender == owner) gates setTradeAddress
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to msg.sender
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom
_msgSender returns the caller controlled msg.sender
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] for the caller
owner guard protects the delegatecall entry point
owner guard protects init
owner guard protects batchSend
owner guard protects setTradeAddress
owner address is whitelisted in ensure and completely bypasses sale restrictions
constructor writes the owner state variable
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked plus/minus
transferFrom deducts allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction
approve overwrites the allowance mapping for the caller
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented without any overflow protection
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum trade amount
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum trade amount
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap
canSale[_from] true short-circuits ensure and skips all sale restrictions
_from == tradeAddress short-circuits ensure and skips all sale restrictions
UNI constant address is part of the ensure whitelist comparison
transfer is implemented by delegating to transferFrom with msg.sender as source
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to succeed before moving balances
ensure calls condition for non whitelisted senders
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address through pairFor
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall to an owner supplied address, allowing storage takeover
callOptionalReturn performs an external low level call to the token before state is finalized
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction can underflow
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition can overflow
_onSaleNum[_from]++ unchecked increment can overflow
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath
_from parameter is the source account debited in transferFrom
_to parameter is the destination account credited in transferFrom
_value parameter drives the allowance spend and balance updates
_spender parameter is the allowance beneficiary
a is the user supplied delegatecall target address
b is the user supplied delegatecall calldata payload
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum
token parameter is scaled and written into _minSale
maxToken parameter is scaled and written into _maxSale
_tos array parameter is iterated to credit each recipient
_value parameter is multiplied by _tos.length and credited per recipient
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress whitelist
loop local _to receives each entry of _tos and is credited
loop index i bounds the batchSend iteration
total local is produced by the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
